_comment: The phases and their gates. The prose home is the roadmap; this is the machine home. Exactly one phase is open at a time; the desk's dashboard shows its gate.
loop: Find a realistic job in Japan or France, apply on the right channel, follow up, learn what gets replies.
cut_list: Automated scraping of boards that block bots

phases.name: Phase 1 — Track the search
phases.gate: Every application from the last week is in the pipeline, and the due list is checked daily.
phases.trap: Building search features before tracking what already works.

phases.name: Phase 2 — Better applications
phases.gate: French and Japan-format documents exported and sent on real applications; fit triage used before applying.
phases.trap: Polishing generators instead of sending applications.

phases.name: Phase 3 — Hygiene
phases.gate: Fresh install runs; README matches the tool.

phases.name: Carried — no phase
phases.gate: Not a phase. Items that outlive one, and references.
